# How we set up a room for recording

A preliminary assessment of the room was conducted.

The rug made more difference than another noise reduction setting.

annotations.quote: A preliminary assessment of the room was conducted.
annotations.why: Name the actions so readers can repeat them.
variants: Before recording, we closed the window and turned off the fan.

annotations.quote: The rug made more difference than another noise reduction setting.
annotations.why: This removes the author's personal comparison.
